chapters.title: Chapter 1: The Atelier
chapters.text: Master Qifrey, a gentle teacher known throughout the Great Hall as the Warden of Silver, adjusted his spectacles. His silver eyes gleamed softly in the candlelight of the Atelier as he instructed his apprentices.

chapters.title: Chapter 2: The Dark Chamber
chapters.text: Late at night within the Atelier, Master Qifrey stared into the dark water basin. His dark obsidian eyes reflected the shadows as he whispered an incantation.

contradictions.description: Eye color changed from silver to dark obsidian without explanation.
